# Ceremony points, read out of the .ptau container by kat-gen's own
# parser (tools/kat-gen/src/srs.rs), independently of crates/srs.
#
#   point g1 <index> <128 hex>   x || y
#   point g2 <index> <256 hex>   x.c0 || x.c1 || y.c0 || y.c1
#
# Every coordinate is canonical 32-byte little-endian, which is *not*
# how the container stores them: .ptau points are little-endian
# Montgomery.
#
